name: Revenue Calculation
description: Calculate total revenue from price and quantity sold.
business_contexts: a retailer totaling revenue from units sold in a period
a manufacturer totaling revenue from a production run
a software company totaling revenue from seats sold
an event organizer totaling revenue from tickets sold
a distributor totaling revenue from units shipped
question_patterns: Given the price and quantity below, what is total revenue?
Calculate total revenue from the price and quantity shown.
What is the total revenue generated, given the price and quantity below?
Calculate revenue by multiplying the price and quantity given.
Using the price and quantity shown, what is total revenue?
key_insight: Revenue is the top line before any cost is subtracted — price times quantity, nothing else.
common_mistakes: Subtracting costs before arriving at revenue, which conflates revenue with profit
Multiplying price by a different volume figure than the one actually sold
framework_soundbite: Revenue is price times quantity — the starting line, not the finish line.
